title: Flavors of Representation Theory
institution: CIMPA (Centre International de Mathématiques Pures et Appliquées)
level: Master's students, doctoral students and early-career researchers
about: CIMPA lists Flavors of Representation Theory, a school at North-Eastern Hill University in Shillong, Meghalaya, India, from 19 to 30 July 2027. Applications are made through CIMPA; the deadline is 19 March 2027.
requirements: See the official CIMPA school page for eligibility
